instruction: Apply italic formatting to the title 'Product Comparison' on page 2.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying italic formatting to title on slide 2. Verified original: italic=None (not italic). Expected: italic=True.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic only checks first text run for italic formatting (line 32 in impress.py), not the entire title text
Instruction requires 'Apply italic formatting to the title' which semantically means the ENTIRE title should be italic, not just the first character/run
In PowerPoint/Impress, text can have per-character/per-run formatting - current logic would incorrectly pass if only first character is italic but rest is not
This creates a false positive risk: partial italic formatting would be counted as complete success
Postconfig and metric comparison logic are correct
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to check ALL runs in the text_frame, not just the first non-empty run
Logic should verify that all runs with text have italic=True, or alternatively that all characters in the title have italic formatting
Consider adding logic: iterate through all paragraphs and all runs, return True only if ALL non-empty runs have italic=True
Example fix: for paragraph in shape.text_frame.paragraphs: for run in paragraph.runs: if run.text.strip() and not run.font.italic: return False; return True
